senses.gloss:
मथ (ए) मथे r. 1st cl. (मथति)
 1. The churn.
 2. To stir or agitate. (इ) मथि
(मन्थति) 1. To hurt or kill.
 2. To afflict.
 3. To suffer pain.

माथ m. (-थः)
 1. Churning, stirring.
 2. A road.
 3. Hurting, injuring,
killing.
 E. माथ् to hurt, aff. अच्; or मथ् to agitate, aff. घञ्.

मथन n. (-नं)
 1. Churning.
 2. Rubbing.
 3. Injury.
 m. (-नः) A tree, the
wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition, (Premna
longifolia.)
 E. मथ् to churn, to stir or rub, aff. ल्युट् ।

मथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Stirred, churned.
 2. Agitated, (mentally,) dis-
tressed, anxious.
 3. Crushed, pinched.
 4. Dislocated.
 n. (-तं)
Butter-milk, without any watery admixture.
 E. मथ् to churn,
aff. क्त ।

मथिन् m. (-न्था)
 1. A churning-stick.
 2. The Penis.
 3. Wind.
 4. The
thunderbolt.
 E. मथि to stir or agitate, aff. इन्, and the nasal
rejected.

मथुरा f. (-रा) A town in the province of Āgrā, celebrated as the birth
place, and early residence of KṚṢṆA, and still an object of
pilgrimage amongst the Hindus.
 E. मथ् to stir, Unādi aff. उरच् ।

मथूरा f. Mathurā.
 E. ऊरच् affixed to मथि, instead of उरच् ।

मथुरेश m. (-शः) A name of KṚṢṆA.
 E. मथुरा a town, and ईश ruler.
माथ् (इ) माथि r. 1st cl. (मान्थति) To hurt or kill, to afflict, to suffer pain.
